dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" REAL NULL, "net_content" REAL NULL, "net_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'g', "purchase_place" TEXT NULL, "purchase_date" INTEGER NULL, "opened_date" INTEGER NULL, "pao_months" INTEGER NULL, "expiry_date" INTEGER NULL, "start_weight" REAL NULL, "empty_bottle_weight" REAL NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_use', "rating" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rating" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "repurchase" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("repurchase" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "finished_date" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "weighed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight" REAL NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_of_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "reminder_time" TEXT NULL, "reminder_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reminder_enabled" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_steps" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "routine_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "step_order" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "usage_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "routine_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "used_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "area" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "score_oil" INTEGER NULL CHECK("score_oil" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "score_moisture" INTEGER NULL CHECK("score_moisture" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "score_acne" INTEGER NULL CHECK("score_acne" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "score_redness" INTEGER NULL CHECK("score_redness" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "score_dullness" INTEGER NULL CHECK("score_dullness" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "sleep_hours" REAL NULL, "stress_level" INTEGER NULL CHECK("stress_level" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "sun_exposure" TEXT NULL, "period_phase" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "daily_entry_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES daily_entries (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "taken_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "thumb_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "session" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("name", "type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entry_tags" ("entry_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES daily_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("entry_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_tags" ("product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_weight_logs_product ON weight_logs (product_id, weighed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_routine_steps_routine ON routine_steps (routine_id, step_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_usage_logs_product ON usage_logs (product_id, used_at)
